verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic official SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), a Cloudflare edge SDK reference, and OpenFeature providers. Community reports independently confirm the mobile/client SDKs, their streaming behavior, and SDK defaults such as timeouts. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation content beyond page titles, and AI-native machine-readable docs (the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404).
